_about: Scripted-move demo for BOARD-ARRANGE1 — replayable user moves on the ?demo=1 board. Run: node ../board-arrange.cjs --moves moves/chiparrange-demo.json --video --slow. The player executes each step through the real gesture handlers (synthetic touch drags), so what the video shows is exactly what a user's fingers would produce.
